purpose: R7-a later-heredoc-body differential corpus (round 4b, 2026-10-17). A substitution opens 2-3 heredocs on one line; an earlier one closes by `DELIM)`. runs53/runs32 were measured with bash 5.3.20 and bash 3.2.57 by `bash -n` plus a `;;` command-position differential on a never-called function wrapping the shape with a harmless stand-in (NEVER executed); regenerate with test/heredoc-later-body/generate.js and label.sh. A shape with runs53 OR runs32 true is one at least one bash runs the removal on, so the guard must DENY it. The gate reads both bash readings and unions their targets (KNOWN-RESIDUALS.md R7-a).
